text:
sarah.ops: Quick sync — wrapping up the DR postmortem. We still have three lingering items: 1) intermittent multi-region routing oddity (traffic bounce to eu-west during peak), 2) nightly backup failures for shard-09, 3) restore runbook gaps (missing snapshot tag validation). Need owners + ETA by EOD.

jamie.sre: I can take the routing oddity. Seen similar spikes tied to LB health-check flaps and our weighted routing policy. Will triage and propose mitigation (sticky weights + health-check cooldown).

tony.eng: I'll own shard-09 backups. I suspect retention policy + vacuum job interference. Will run a one-off restore test in staging tomorrow and post logs.

lina.pm: Thanks. For restore runbook I'll pair with whoever owns backups — we should add an explicit step to verify snapshot tags and a preflight check (size + timestamp). Lina: assigning to @tony.eng + @lina.pm and recommending a canary restore.

michael.oncall: oncall-bot noted two automated alerts last week: "backup_failure shard-09" and "route_anomaly eu-west". Posting the alert snippets:
```
ALERT backup_failure: shard-09 failed snapshot, exit code 23, timeout 600s
ALERT route_anomaly: sudden 20% traffic re-route to eu-west for 3m
```

oncall-bot: Reminder: game-day dry run next wednesday 09:00 UTC. RSVP with :white_check_mark:.

jamie.sre: Quick note — the routing bounce pattern looks recurring every Thursday 18:00-19:30 UTC in the last 3 weeks. Could be related to cross-region backup traffic or a batch job. I'll add instrumentation to trace-by-request-region.

sarah.ops: Good catch. Make that a task: "add per-request region tracing". Owner: jamie.sre. ETA: 72h.

tony.eng: Backup test plan: 1) run manual snapshot 2) attempt restore to staging 3) validate data + timing 4) check for interference with vacuum. I'll post results and a remediation PR (config tweak + alert on failure). ETA: 48h.

lina.pm: For runbook updates I'll draft the new checklist items and a preflight script snippet. Proposal: add `aws ec2 describe-snapshots --filters Name=tag:service,Values=redwood` step and hash-compare. Will ping for review.

jamie.sre: One more: during triage I saw some LB health-check retries spike when cross-region peer syncs run. Short-term mitigation: increase backend health-check threshold from 2->5 and add 30s cooldown before weight shift. We should test impact in canary.

michael.oncall: Logging owners and timelines in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.internal/dr/1725556789 (I'll create page). Also scheduling game-day dry run invites now.

sarah.ops: Summary action items:
- jamie.sre: investigate routing oddity + add tracing + propose LB health-check cooldown (ETA 72h)
- tony.eng: backup restore test + PR for retention/vacuum scheduling (ETA 48h)
- lina.pm + tony.eng: update restore runbook with snapshot tag validation + canary restore steps (ETA 72h)
- michael.oncall: Confluence page + schedule game-day dry run (ETA 24h)

sarah.ops: We'll reconvene after the canary restore and the tracing instrumentation. If anyone needs to reassign, reply here. :thumbsup:

jamie.sre: Ack, starting instrument work now.

tony.eng: Starting backup test in ~30m, will update with logs.

lina.pm: Drafting runbook changes, sharing shortly.

oncall-bot: Note: automated post in 24h to check-in on outstanding tasks.
